meta.notice: SYNTHETIC DATA ONLY. Every name, Student Number, contact number, allergy, condition, and event in this file is fictional. No real Mendez Christian Academy student or staff member appears here, ever: these are minors' health records under RA 10173 (Data Privacy Act of 2012), and this repository is public. Never paste real records into this file.
meta.purpose: Seed data for the CLINIQ frontend mock layer (ADR-006, ADR-014). Hand-edit this file to change what every screen shows; see README.md next to it.
meta.dates: All dates are relative to the injectable "today" in the data layer: {"daysAgo": n} or {"daysFromNow": n}, plus "time": "HH:MM" (Philippine time) for timestamps.
meta.derivedValues: Only raw records live here. Counts, flags, statuses like low-stock / overdue / incomplete, and report contents are computed by selectors in src/lib/mock-db/. The integrity test fails if you store one.
meta.schema: Frontend-facing shapes from CLINIQ_Frontend_Context_Brief.md §5. This is NOT a database design; the ERD is a proposed draft, not final or approved.

config._note: OPEN PRODUCT DECISIONS: none of these values is defined in the requirements. They are carried over from the Dashboard mock so screens have something to show. See ADR-014.

vitalsWarningRanges._note: PLACEHOLDER SANITY BOUNDS, NOT CLINICAL THRESHOLDS. Nurse to confirm (Issues-and-TODOs: 'Unusual-vitals thresholds'). A reading outside a range is very unlikely to be real, usually a typing slip such as 370 for 37.0. The Incident and Visit forms show a warning and never block saving. oxygenSaturationPct (the oximeter) is null on purpose: no warning until the clinician gives a range; set {"min", "max"} here when she does. feverFromC: a temperature at or above it (37 °C, the team's rule of October 20, 2026; clinician to confirm) is flagged as a fever, also never blocking.
